verdict.rationale: Godot's docs describe an automatic import pipeline: scene files placed in the project folder are imported automatically, import parameters can be batch-edited, and import plugins can add custom formats as first-class resources. None of the evidence names glTF, FBX or USD, so clean import of these specific formats is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of glTF, FBX and USD import support, evidence of import fidelity, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
